usage: GetTruth.py [-h] --vcf_fn VCF_FN [--var_fn VAR_FN] [--ctgName CTGNAME]
                   [--ctgStart CTGSTART] [--ctgEnd CTGEND]
                   [--truth_vcf_fn TRUTH_VCF_FN]

Extract variant type and allele from a truth dataset

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --vcf_fn VCF_FN       Truth VCF file input, required
  --var_fn VAR_FN       Truth variants output, use PIPE for standard output,
                        default: PIPE
  --ctgName CTGNAME     The name of sequence to be processed
  --ctgStart CTGSTART   The 1-based starting position of the sequence to be
                        processed
  --ctgEnd CTGEND       The 1-based inclusive ending position of the sequence
                        to be processed
  --truth_vcf_fn TRUTH_VCF_FN
                        Truth VCF file input, only used when vcf_fn is unified
                        vcf. Marked truth variants not in unified as missing
